arxiv-2006-04747.title: Secure Byzantine-Robust Machine Learning
arxiv-2006-04747.creator: Lie He, Sai Praneeth Karimireddy, Martin Jaggi
arxiv-2006-04747.description: Abstract Increasingly machine learning systems are being deployed to edge servers and devices (e.g. mobile phones) and trained in a collaborative manner. Such distributed/federated/decentralized training raises a number of concerns about the robustness, privacy, and security of the procedure. While extensive work has been done in tackling with robustness, privacy, or security individually, their combination has rarely been studied.

arxiv-2111-13610.title: Spectrally Multiplexed Hong-Ou-Mandel Interference
arxiv-2111-13610.creator: Oriol Pietx-Casas, Gustavo Castro do Amaral, Tanmoy Chakraborty, Remon Berrevoets, Thomas Middelburg, Joshua Slater, Wolfgang Tittel
arxiv-2111-13610.description: Abstract We explore the suitability of a Virtually-Imaged Phased Array (VIPA) as a Spectral-to-Spatial Mode-Mapper (SSMM) for applications in quantum communication such as a quantum repeater. To this end we demonstrate spectrally-resolved two-photon “Hong-Ou-Mandel” (HOM) interference. Spectral sidebands are generated on a common optical carrier and weak coherent pulses are prepared in each spectral mode.

arxiv-2301-11309.title: SemSup-XC: Semantic Supervision for Zero and Few-shot Extreme Classification
arxiv-2301-11309.creator: Pranjal Aggarwal, Ameet Deshpande, Karthik Narasimhan
arxiv-2301-11309.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pranjal Aggarwal, Ameet Deshpande, Karthik Narasimhan. Extreme classification (XC) involves predicting over large numbers of classes (thousands to millions), with real-world applications like news article classification and e-commerce product tagging. The zero-shot version of this task requires generalization to novel classes without additional supervision. In this paper, we develop SemSup-XC, a model that achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot and few-shot performance on three XC datasets derived from legal, e-commerce, and Wikipedia data.

arxiv-2402-11868.title: Recent Extensions of the ZKCM Library for Parallel and Accurate MPS Simulation of Quantum Circuits
arxiv-2402-11868.creator: Akira SaiToh
arxiv-2402-11868.description: Abstract A C++ library ZKCM and its extension library ZKCM_QC have been developed since 2011 for multiple-precision matrix computation and accurate matrix-product-state (MPS) quantum circuit simulation, respectively. In this report, a recent progress in the extensions of these libraries is described, which are mainly for parallel processing with the OpenMP and CUDA frameworks.

arxiv-2503-21676.title: How do language models learn facts? Dynamics, curricula and hallucinations
arxiv-2503-21676.creator: Nicolas Zucchet, Jörg Bornschein, Stephanie Chan, Andrew Lampinen, Razvan Pascanu, Soham De
arxiv-2503-21676.description: Abstract Large language models accumulate vast knowledge during pre-training, yet the dynamics governing this acquisition remain poorly understood. This work investigates the learning dynamics of language models on a synthetic factual recall task, uncovering three key findings: First, language models learn in three phases, exhibiting a performance plateau before acquiring precise factual knowledge.

arxiv-2504-06005.title: A deep search for Complex Organic Molecules toward the protoplanetary disk of V883 Ori Facilities: ALMA
arxiv-2504-06005.creator: Abubakar M. A. Fadul, Kamber R. Schwarz, Merel L. R. van ’t Hoff, Jane Huang, Jennifer B. Bergner, Tushar Suhasaria, Jenny K. Calahan
arxiv-2504-06005.description: Abstract Complex Organic Molecules (COMs) in the form of prebiotic molecules are potentially building blocks of life. Using Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) Band 7 observations in spectral scanning mode, we carried out a deep search for COMs within the disk of V883 Ori, covering frequency ranges of ∼ \sim 348 – 366 GHz.

arxiv-2506-23280.title: BAPE: Learning an Explicit Bayes Classifier for Long-tailed Visual Recognition
arxiv-2506-23280.creator: Chaoqun Du, Yulin Wang, Shiji Song, Gao Huang, gaohuang@tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2506-23280.description: Abstract Bayesian decision theory advocates the Bayes classifier as the optimal approach for minimizing the risk in machine learning problems. Current deep learning algorithms usually solve for the optimal classifier by implicitly estimating the posterior probabilities, e.g. , by minimizing the Softmax cross-entropy loss. This simple methodology has been proven effective for meticulously balanced academic benchmark datasets.

arxiv-2507-06154.title: What’s my phase again? Computing the vacuum-to-vacuum amplitude of quadratic bosonic evolution
arxiv-2507-06154.creator: Nicolás Quesada
arxiv-2507-06154.description: Abstract Quadratic bosonic Hamiltonians and their associated unitary transformations form a fundamental class of operations in quantum optics, modeling key processes such as squeezing, displacement, and beam-splitting. Their Heisenberg-picture dynamics simplifies to linear (or possibly affine) transformations on quadrature operators, enabling efficient analysis and decomposition into optical gate sets using matrix operations.

arxiv-2507-14971.title: Quadrature formulas from rational approximations Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2507-14971.creator: Andrew Horning, Lloyd N. Trefethen ()
arxiv-2507-14971.description: Abstract It is shown that quadrature formulas in many different applications can be derived from rational approximation of the Cauchy transform of a weight function. Since rational approximation is now a routine technology, this provides an easy new method to derive all kinds of quadrature formulas as well as fundamental insight into the mathematics of quadrature.

pmc-11458770.title: MYC-rearranged mature B-cell lymphomas in children and young adults are molecularly Burkitt Lymphoma
pmc-11458770.creator: Sara Mato, Natalia Castrejón-de-Anta, Ariadna Colmenero, Lorenzo Carità, Julia Salmerón-Villalobos, Joan Enric Ramis-Zaldivar, Ferran Nadeu, Noelia Garcia, Luojun Wang, Jaime Verdú-Amorós, Mara Andrés, Nuria Conde, Verónica Celis, Maria José Ortega, Ana Galera, Itziar Astigarraga, Vanesa Perez-Alons
pmc-11458770.description: Aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphomas (NHL) in children, adolescents, and young adults (CAYA) include Burkitt lymphoma (BL), diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), and a subset of high-grade tumors with features intermediate between these entities whose genetic and molecular profiles have not been completely elucidated.

pmc-11496192.title: Cytomegalovirus tracheobronchitis mimicking lung cancer progression in a patient with lung adenocarcinoma: A case report
pmc-11496192.creator: Green Hong, Sung Joon Han, Kyung‐Hee Kim, Dongil Park, Chaeuk Chung
pmc-11496192.description: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) commonly infects immunocompromised individuals, such as cancer patients. We present a case involving a 60‐year‐old male with Stage 3A lung adenocarcinoma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) diagnosed with CMV tracheobronchitis, initially suspected as cancer progression. Treatment with ganciclovir led to partial improvement in symptoms of shortness of breath and cough, as well as bronchoscopic findings.

pmc-11655850.title: Tumor- and host-derived heparanase-2 (Hpa2) attenuates tumorigenicity: role of Hpa2 in macrophage polarization and BRD7 nuclear localization
pmc-11655850.creator: Soaad Soboh, Avital Vorontsova, Malik Farhoud, Uri Barash, Inna Naroditsky, Miriam Gross-Cohen, Marina Weissmann, Yasuhiko Nishioka, Adrian S. Woolf, Neil A. Roberts, Yuval Shaked, Neta Ilan, Israel Vlodavsky
pmc-11655850.description: Little attention was given to heparanase 2 (Hpa2) over the last two decades, possibly because it lacks a heparan sulfate (HS)-degrading activity typical of heparanase. Emerging results suggest, nonetheless, that Hpa2 plays a role in human pathologies, including cancer progression where it functions as a tumor suppressor. Here, we examined the role of Hpa2 in cervical carcinoma.

pmc-12522999.creator: Bin Xie, Siman Lei, Yiren Wu, Infong Chang, Mengyun Zhao, Fangyuan Ju
pmc-12522999.description: BackgroundPhysical literacy and social responsibility are crucial educational outcomes that foster lifelong physical activity and prosocial behaviors. The Teaching Personal and Social Responsibility (TPSR) model, which is widely applied to cultivate a positive character through sports and movement-based activities, promotes physical competence, self-regulation, and prosocial behavior. However, research on its effectiveness in primary schools is limited.

pmc-12622705.title: Public attention related to epidural labor analgesia in mainland China: Evidence from internet search data
pmc-12622705.creator: Xinzhu Zhu, Xu Wang, Xuetong Zhang, Peiwen Jia, Guannan He, Fengshou Chen
pmc-12622705.description: The Baidu index (BDI) is a publicly available data platform that reflects search volume and user attention trends based on massive behavioral data from its users. Utilizing this tool, this study aimed to investigate the public search trends and level of understanding regarding “epidural labor analgesia (ELA)” in mainland China.

pmc-12725619.title: Bacterial gene 5′ ends have unusual mutation rates that can mislead tests of selection
pmc-12725619.creator: Sofia Radrizzani, Juan Rivas-Santisteban, Namshik Han, Laurence D. Hurst
pmc-12725619.description: Despite early assumptions of neutrality, numerous mechanisms are now thought to cause selection on synonymous mutations, commonly supported by a low evolutionary rate at synonymous sites (Ks). This has been best evidenced in the first ~10 codons of genes in E. coli, where Ks is less than around half that of the gene body.

pmc-13092240.description: BackgroundLeiomyosarcoma (LMS) is an aggressive soft tissue sarcoma with high rates of hematogenous metastasis and recurrent relapse, with a 5-year survival rate of 17.0%. pmc-13312124.creator: Shaohui Xie, Lulu Ding, Ling Liu, Yew Soon Ong, Jianqiang Li, Zexuan Zhu, Jianlin Cheng
pmc-13312124.description: MotivationHigh-fidelity simulation of nanopore sequencing signals is critical for rigorous benchmarking and validation of the nanopore signal processing pipeline. uslaw-usc-t10-s9218.title: 10 U.S.C. § 9218 — Duties: warrant officers; limitations
uslaw-usc-t10-s9218.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s9218.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 923 (Special Appointments, Assignments, Details, And Duties). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Under regulations prescribed by the President, a warrant officer may be assigned to perform duties that necessarily include those normally performed by a commissioned officer.

uslaw-usc-t16-s8501.title: 16 U.S.C. § 8501 — Promotion of outdoor recreation for military servicemembers and veterans
uslaw-usc-t16-s8501.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s8501.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 103 (Expanding Public Lands Outdoor Recreation Experiences); Subchapter II (Access America); Part B (Military And Veterans In Parks). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Not later than 2 years after January 4, 2025, the Secretary concerned, in coordination with the Secretary of Veterans Affairs and the Secretary of Defense, shall develop educational and public awareness materials.

uslaw-usc-t33-s1475.title: 33 U.S.C. § 1475 — Consultation procedure
uslaw-usc-t33-s1475.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t33-s1475.description: United States Code, Title 33 (Navigation And Navigable Waters); Chapter 28 (Pollution Casualties On The High Seas: United States Intervention). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Before taking any measure under section 1474 of this title, the Secretary shall— (1) consult, through the Secretary of State, with other countries affected by the marine casualty, and particularly with the flag country of any ship.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
